senses.d: Free of restrictions, limitations, qualifications or conditions; unconditional.

ex: An absolute monarch is free from all forcible restraint, and so far as he is absolute[,] from all legal restraints of positive laws.

senses.d: Characteristic of an absolutist ruler: domineering, peremptory.
ex: The peddler stopped, and tapped her on the head, / With absolute forefinger, brown and ringed.

senses.d: Complete, utter, outright; unmitigated, not qualified or diminished in any way.

senses.d: Positive, certain; unquestionable; not in doubt.
